song.title: I Feel Like Traveling On
song.lyrics:
[V1] . G My heavenly home Is bright and fair, . D7 I feel like traveling on, . G No pain, nor death Can enter there, . D7 G I feel like traveling on.
[C1] . G Yes, I feel like traveling on, . D7 I feel like traveling on; . G My heavenly home Is bright and fair, . D7 G I feel like traveling on.
[V2] . G Its glittering towers the sun outshine, . D7 I feel like traveling on; . G That heavenly mansion shall be mine, . D7 G I feel like traveling on.
[V3] . G Let others seek a home below, . D7 I feel like traveling on; . G Which flames devour, Or waves o'er flow, . D7 G I feel like traveling on.
[V4] . G The Lord has been so good to me, . D7 I feel like traveling on; . G Until that blessed home I see, . D7 G I feel like traveling on.
